build_voting_module: build a VotingModule with a vote factor and seed feature dimension for 3D object detection
run_voting_module_forward: run the VotingModule forward pass with seed XYZ coordinates and seed features to generate votes
test_voting_module: test the VotingModule class by instantiating it and passing random seed XYZ and feature tensors
review_voting_module_forward: review the VotingModule forward method that generates vote XYZ offsets and residual features from seed points
summarize_voting_module: summarize the VotingModule class that generates votes from seed point XYZ coordinates and features using conv layers
